sources.title: Introducing Cono 1.5 - Arcanic AI
sources.snippet: Cono is an advanced large language model (LLM) developed based on the Mistral-7B-v0.1 base model from Mistral AI. One of the key enhancements of Cono is its extended context length, which reaches up to 16,000 tokens.
